title: Security Deposits Waiver Grounds and Security Instruments Accepted by Tier
content:
Which grounds can stand in place of a cash Security Deposits payment depends on the tier. The table sets out, for each tier, whether a prior-utility letter or good payment history on another Cedar Fork service account of the same member waives the deposit, whether a surety bond or an irrevocable bank letter of credit may stand in place of cash, and whether a waived account later disconnected for nonpayment is assessed a deposit.

## Grounds by tier

| Tier | Prior-utility letter waives | Cedar Fork history waives | Surety bond accepted | Letter of credit accepted | Waived account disconnected for nonpayment is assessed a deposit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential Standard Deposit | yes | yes | no | no | yes |
| Residential Credit Reestablishment Deposit | no | no | no | no | no |
| Seasonal Residence Deposit | yes | yes | no | no | yes |
| Farm Service Deposit | yes | yes | no | no | yes |
| General Service Deposit | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Irrigation and Large Power Deposit | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |

## Standards behind each ground

| Tier | Months of service the letter must cover | Most late payments the letter may show | Largest age of the letter, calendar days before the assessed date | Months of good history required on the other Cedar Fork account | Shortest remaining term of a bond or letter of credit, months | Days before expiry at which renewal is asked for |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential Standard Deposit | 12 | 1 | 60 | 12 | 12 | 60 |
| Residential Credit Reestablishment Deposit | 12 | 1 | 60 | 12 | 12 | 60 |
| Seasonal Residence Deposit | 12 | 1 | 60 | 12 | 12 | 60 |
| Farm Service Deposit | 12 | 1 | 60 | 12 | 12 | 60 |
| General Service Deposit | 12 | 1 | 60 | 24 | 12 | 60 |
| Irrigation and Large Power Deposit | 12 | 1 | 60 | 24 | 12 | 60 |

The second table gives the standard a ground must meet; it is applied only on a tier where the first table opens that ground.

## Points of reading

- A letter dated exactly 60 calendar days before the assessed date is within the age limit; one dated 61 days before is not.
- A letter showing one late payment is within the standard; two late payments are not.
- On the General Service Deposit and the Irrigation and Large Power Deposit the other Cedar Fork account must show 24 months of good history; on the other waiving tiers, 12 months.
